acts.desc: Host Ira Glass joins a group of tourists to walk through the captured German submarine that's on permanent display at Chicago's Museum of Science and Industry. He notes that the Museum chooses to underplay the murderous Nazi origins of the boat. He then makes some broad generalizations that lead, inevitably, to the introduction to our story on Hitler's Yacht.

Act One
acts.desc: Reporter Alix Spiegel tells the story of the Ostwind, the boat that came to be known as "Hitler's Yacht."
